$comment: Taste questions: the few choices that decide a film and that RasanAI can't infer. One source of truth for the Studio's setup flow (one question per screen) and for the skill (the PREFERENCES block, presenter.mjs check/build, learn.mjs infer). A format option lists the ids it asks in formats.json `questions`. `unsure` hands the call to RasanAI. `ask_if` limits a question to films where it means something. Answers are stored as { <question id>: <choice id> } in rasanai-brief.json `preferences` and in a series' series.json `preferences`. `brief_fields` are optional free-text brief fields that are not taste choices (kept out of `questions`, so the setup flow and the preferences check never see them): reference_films feeds scripts/refs.mjs.

brief_fields.question: Any reference films you love?
brief_fields.description: Video files, a folder of them, or links (YouTube/Vimeo). RasanAI measures them and reads how they are cut, paced and scored, then aims at those targets. They inform the film; nothing from them is ever copied in.
brief_fields.setup: RasanAI Studio asks it as the Reference films screen (file and folder drops, a file picker, pasted links)

questions.question: What should the pictures be like?

choices.label: One running world
choices.description: Every idea happens in one place that changes as the talk goes on.

choices.label: Bold ideas
choices.description: Pictures that add a second meaning to what's said.

choices.label: Plain and literal
choices.description: Show the actual thing that's named: the real book cover, the bread and the wine.

choices.label: Large, always in the same place
choices.description: The speaker never moves; the pictures change around them.

choices.label: Moves with the story
choices.description: Full, beside the picture, in a corner: the layout changes with what's said.

choices.label: Moves, and sometimes leaves
choices.description: As above, plus moments where only the picture is on screen and the voice carries on.

choices.label: None
choices.description: Only pictures. The voice says everything.

choices.label: Key words only
choices.description: A name, a title or a number now and then.

choices.label: Full graphics
choices.description: Titles, labels, lists and numbers that move with the talk.

choices.label: No captions
choices.description: Nothing at the bottom of the screen.

choices.label: Plain captions
choices.description: Quiet white words, easy to read.

choices.label: Styled captions
choices.description: Bold words that light up as they're spoken.

questions.question: There's a mark in your video (a badge, logo or watermark). Keep it?

choices.label: Keep it visible
choices.description: Nothing is ever placed over it.

choices.label: Cover it
choices.description: Captions or graphics may sit on top of it.

choices.label: My end card
choices.description: A picture or clip you choose, added after the last word.

choices.label: RasanAI makes one
choices.description: A closing card in the film's look.

choices.label: No end card
choices.description: It ends on the last word.
